notes.title: Polar Pathways is out now!
notes.content:
🥳 Our lil penguin game is out now! 🥳 🐧Thank you all for your support on our discord, on our socials and even in our in person events! 🐧 

☃️ We hope you have fun waddling and sliding around in our world! ☃️ 

❄️The perfect game to play with a young one as there's no pressures or constraints, works on a controller and is short and cute! ❄️ ✨Please let us know your thoughts and share the game with our friends, it helps our indie team a lot ✨
